title: Samsung profits jump 1,800% as AI chip sales soar
facts: Samsung Electronics forecast a 19-fold increase in quarterly operating profits driven by artificial intelligence memory chip demand.
Samsung Electronics projected an operating profit of 89.4 trillion won for the quarter spanning April to June.
The projected quarterly operating profit represents the third consecutive record quarterly profit for Samsung Electronics.
Samsung Electronics reported estimated sales of approximately 171 trillion won for the second quarter.
Samsung Electronics' second-quarter sales more than doubled compared to the same period in the previous year.
Marc Einstein serves as an industry analyst at the research firm Counterpoint Research.
Bryan Ma serves as a technology devices researcher at the market intelligence firm IDC.
Samsung Electronics manufactures semiconductor chips for major technology companies including Nvidia and Google.
Samsung Electronics' share price dropped nearly 7% in Seoul following the release of its earnings guidance.
Samsung Electronics' stock market valuation has more than doubled since the beginning of 2024.
South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix saw its stock value increase by more than 200% in 2024.
South Korea's benchmark Kospi share index gained more than 80% in 2024.
Nvidia generated more than $80 billion in revenue during the quarter from January to March.
South Korea unveiled plans for at least $880 billion in investments for chip manufacturing led by Samsung and SK Hynix.
Semiconductor manufacturers in Japan, China, and Taiwan are expanding investments in chip factories to meet global demand.
